definitions.explanation: The technology or process by which a computer identifies and processes objects, faces, text, or patterns within digital images.

examples.japanese: {画像認識|がぞうにんしき}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進歩|しんぽ}している。
このアプリは{画像認識|がぞうにんしき}で{植物|しょくぶつ}の{名前|なまえ}を{調|しら}べられる。
examples.english: This app can identify plant names using image recognition.

examples.japanese: {自動運転|じどううんてん}には{高精度|こうせいど}な{画像認識|がぞうにんしき}が{不可欠|ふかけつ}だ。
examples.english: High-precision image recognition is essential for autonomous driving.

notes:
A compound of {画像|がぞう} (image; picture) and {認識|にんしき} (recognition; perception). A key term in modern technology, especially in AI and machine learning. Image recognition is used in everything from smartphone cameras to medical diagnostics and self-driving cars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画像認識|がぞうにんしき}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: image recognition technology
- {画像認識|がぞうにんしき}AI: image recognition AI
- {画像認識|がぞうにんしき}を{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize image recognition
- {画像認識|がぞうにんしき}の{精度|せいど}: accuracy of image recognition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {顔認証|かおにんしょう}: facial authentication — specifically identifying individuals by their face for security purposes
- {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}: speech recognition — the audio equivalent, converting spoken words to text
- {文字認識|もじにんしき}: character recognition (OCR) — specifically recognizing printed or handwritten characters
